title: UGC ad or testimonial
summary: A person on camera talks about the product in a native, creator-style vertical video (hook, problem, product in use, proof, CTA), 15-60 s, for TikTok, Reels and Shorts ads or organic posts.

notFor.when: the user wants their recording cut, captioned or reframed with no ad structure (hook, proof, CTA) and nothing to sell
a recorded customer interview built into a story (situation, problem, what changed) of 60 s or more, with cut-downs
a promo built in motion design around the product with no person talking to camera
several short clips cut out of a long recording such as a podcast or webinar
teaching how to use the product step by step on its screens
nobody was filmed and the user wants a generated presenter or avatar to speak (never as a customer testimonial)

alternatives.when: the takes, word timings, music and a sourced proof claim are supplied and the user wants a headline on every beat and an end card (hook, problem, demo, proof, CTA)

qa: The first 3 s carry the hook and name or show the product or its proposition; no logo intro
When the speaker has a material connection (paid, gifted, employee, affiliate), Ad or Paid partnership is said and shown (burned captions) in the first seconds, plus the platform label
Every claim is the speaker's own experience in their own words; no splice puts words in their mouth; results beyond the typical carry what is typical
Product screens are the real product; inserted B-roll has checked advertising rights
For a paid placement, captions clear the ad interface (footage:next --placement ad passes captions:place --placement ad); an on-screen CTA is checked on the platform's ad safe-zone template
Paid ads carry only commercially licensed music, never a trending sound taken from the feed

intake.ask: Is the video already recorded? Who is on camera: you, a hired creator, or a real customer?
intake.why: No footage means a creator brief, not a film; a customer testimonial needs consent and unscripted words

intake.ask: What ties the speaker to the brand: paid, gifted product, employee, affiliate code, or nothing?
intake.why: Any material connection needs an upfront Ad or Paid partnership label (FTC Endorsement Guides, ASA/CAP)

intake.ask: Paid ad or organic post, and on which of TikTok, Reels and Shorts?
intake.why: Ads reserve a larger bottom band, need licensed music and the creator's ad authorisation (Spark code, partnership ad)
intake.default: Organic on TikTok, Reels and Shorts, one vertical cut

intake.ask: Which claims will the speaker make, and what proves each one?
intake.why: Testimonials may not imply atypical results; the proof beat needs a source
intake.default: Only the speaker's own experience, no numbers or comparisons

intake.ask: What is the one action at the end, in its exact words (link, code, install)?
intake.why: One CTA, spoken and on screen, matching the platform's button
intake.default: The platform CTA button, with a short spoken CTA

intake.ask: Should real product screens be inserted? Which app or site, and a test account?
intake.why: Screens must be the real product (capture:app), not a stand-in
intake.default: No inserts; the product is shown in the speaker's hands

profiles.note: TikTok recommends 21-34 s for most ads, a hook in the first 3 s and the proposition in the first 3 s; use the Commercial Music Library in ads
Meta's Reels ads guide: 9:16, with audio, captions and CTA inside the safe zone; branded content carries the Paid partnership label
Shorts run up to 3 min (YouTube Help), but the ad keeps the 15-60 s band; tick paid promotion so YouTube shows its disclosure label at the start

starter.note: The creator-content caption presets: outline pop and yellow italic shadow for loud talking heads, key-word colour to land the product name or the number

variants.title: Customer testimonial as a native ad
variants.changes: The speaker is a real customer: written consent and usage rights before cutting, no script handed to them, recut:plan cuts only waste (no reordering), a typical-results line when their result is exceptional, and an insider or incentive disclosed (FTC 16 CFR 465).

variants.title: Brief for a creator, before the shoot
variants.changes: No footage yet: the deliverable is a brief, not a film. Hook variants and a 15/30/60 s script (copywriter, ugc-content-creator), a shot list and recording spec (recording-guide), performance notes (directing-and-performance), the disclosure said to camera in the first seconds, and usage rights. The footage route starts when the takes arrive.

variants.title: Several hooks over one body
variants.changes: The creator records the whole script once per hook. Each take is its own source project and recut (project:new, then footage:next --project <id>-hook-b --playbook ugc-ad --source <take>), so no hook is spliced onto another take's body; 3-5 variants per ad group is TikTok's guidance.
